bull_case_summary: IHH has ex-MFRS129 operating growth and H1 ex-exceptional profit up 22%. Round two accepts the dividend gap but argues an improving hospital engine and positive RM141m post-financing cash preserve a retention-and-growth thesis.
bear_case_summary: The bear accepts underlying growth but retains RM486m dividends versus RM141m cash after specified obligations. RM11.564bn net debt before leases and 30.38x trailing valuation make continued growth and payout decisions important to shareholder conversion.
key_points_of_agreement: Underlying growth survives accounting and exceptional-item objections.
Conservative cash remains positive but does not cover dividends.
No prospective payout adjustment or adverse legal outcome is an observed fact.
key_points_of_disagreement: Whether profitable growth adequately compensates leverage and the current payout shortfall at a premium valuation.
unresolved_uncertainties: Actual retained cash, payout choices and future conversion.
Governance/legal outcomes and Singapore admissions recovery, without presumed adverse conclusions.
